easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Changeling Titan must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Titan for its mana cost.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
